Geographies Served Programs Library Program- Building an Imagination Haven District South Kannada Bangalore Pune Mumbai State Karnataka Maharashtra District South Kannada Bangalore Pune Mumbai States Karnataka Maharashtra Our libraries are more than just places for reading; they are sanctuaries for the imagination, offering access to a world of stories and knowledge. Our libraries are not mere repositories of books; they are immersive Imagination Havens. Not only the books but the murals and design of the library is based on a specific theme and holds a meaning. Each library is carefully designed and named. A special attention is paid to every detail so that the children find it welcoming and they feel belonged. These carefully curated spaces are designed to transport children into the world of literature, knowledge, and dreams. We offer a diverse collection of books that cater to various interests and reading levels, making it accessible to every child to find stories that resonate with them. Our libraries provide a haven where children can escape the confines of their everyday lives, journey into distant lands and historical eras, and explore different worlds. These spaces go beyond the promotion of l Storytelling Program District South Kannada Bangalore Pune Mumbai State Karnataka Maharashtra District South Kannada Bangalore Pune Mumbai States Karnataka Maharashtra Storytelling is the core component of our approach towards healing and empowerment and transformation. Through storytelling sessions, we encourage children to connect with stories, identify with the characters, and delve into their own emotions within a safe and supportive environment. Our storytellers guide children through narratives that resonate with their experiences, helping them to relate, reflect, and develop empathy. Storytelling is a powerful tool for processing trauma and building resilience. It empowers children to share their own stories and experiences, thereby regaining a sense of control over their lives. Additionally, reflective questions allow children to think, understand and apply the value learnt. Thus, reflective questions play a huge role in the storytelling program. Story Sparklers Program- Value Reinforcement activities District South Kannada Bangalore Pune Mumbai State Karnataka Maharashtra District South Kannada Bangalore Pune Mumbai States Karnataka Maharashtra The Story Sparklers Program is designed to ignite the sparks of creativity and self-expression in children. We offer activities and exercises that challenge children to think critically, imagine freely, and express themselves through various artistic means. The purpose of Story Sparklers Program is to further supplement the values narrated in the stories and help children make sense of the value, understand the practical use of it and develop a functional approach to understand and apply the value in real life. Additionally, these activities not only help children discover their creative talents but also foster essential life skills such as problem-solving, communication, and emotional intelligence. Story Sparklers Program empowers children to develop a strong sense of self-worth, encouraging them to view themselves as capable individuals who can shape their own destinies. Buddy Program District South Kannada Bangalore Pune Mumbai State Karnataka Maharashtra District South Kannada Bangalore Pune Mumbai States Karnataka Maharashtra Our Buddy Program pairs children with our volunteers who serve as mentors and friends. These dedicated individuals offer consistent support and guidance, serving as role models for the children. The buddy relationship provides children with a safe space to discuss their thoughts and feelings, learn valuable life skills, and build a sense of trust and belonging. These bonds not only help children navigate their emotions and challenges but also instill a sense of hope. Through one-on-one interactions and group activities, the Buddy Program creates a supportive network that reminds children they are not alone in their journeys. Magic Crate Program State Karnataka Tamil Nadu Delhi Goa Maharashtra Andaman and Nicobar Islands States Karnataka Tamil Nadu Delhi Goa Maharashtra Andaman and Nicobar Islands The Magic Crate Program delivers carefully curated storybooks and activities to the doorsteps of children, enriching their learning experience. These specially designed and curated crates are dispatched to various community hubs like police stations, counseling centers, children’s homes, and more, serving as portals to the enchanting world of literature and learning for children. Packed with carefully selected storybooks, engaging activity books, and educational resources, the Magic Crates extend the joy of reading to spaces where children gather. Library Monitor program District South Kannada Bangalore Pune Mumbai State Karnataka Maharashtra District South Kannada Bangalore Pune Mumbai States Karnataka Maharashtra In the context of the Library Monitor Program at Bookwallah, paying careful attention to details showcases important leadership skills.. Library Monitors demonstrate organizational prowess by meticulously cataloging and shelving books, creating an environment where every detail is considered to enhance accessibility. This skill set not only ensures an efficient library system but also showcases leadership through responsibility and initiative. Leadership extends beyond administrative tasks to encompass the cultivation of a thriving reading community. The encouragement of children to share their reading lists and the motivation to actively participate in library sessions highlight interpersonal and motivational leadership skills. Monitors act as role models, inspiring their peers to engage in the reading adventure with enthusiasm and curiosity. Over the course of three months, interns actively engage in Session Planning, collaborating closely with Storywallahs to craft captivating session plans. This involvement not only enhances the learning environment for children but also fosters the intern’s creative and organizational skills. Through this collaborative process, the intern develops a deeper understanding of how to curate content that aligns with the diverse interests of the young audience, thereby contributing to a more impactful and tailored learning experience.
